requirement.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirement.normalizedRequirement: IF ship_operates_in_low_air_temperature = true, THEN every released rescue boat and lifeboat shall carry at least one ship-to-shore distress-alert device, one location-signal device, and one on-scene transmit/receive communication device.
requirement.requiredInputs: Operating-temperature class, craft inventory, and assigned device inventory
requirement.section: Part I-A Chapter 10 - Survival craft communications
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: For ships intended to operate in low air temperature, all rescue boats and lifeboats, whenever released for evacuation, shall: for distress alerting, carry one device for transmitting ship-to-shore alerts; in order to be located, carry one device for transmitting signals for location; and for on-scene communications, carry one device for transmitting and receiving on-scene communications.
